# Utkarsh Gupta - AI, Analytics & Automation Consultant

> Utkarsh Gupta is an independent AI, Analytics, and Automation consultant with 6+ years of experience. He helps B2C, D2C, and B2B companies build data-driven capabilities, implement AI-powered automation, and develop intelligent analytics systems. Based in India, serving clients globally.

## Services

- [AI & Machine Learning Consulting](https://utkarshgupta.com/services/ai-consulting.html): Custom AI model development, NLP solutions, predictive analytics, and AI agent deployment for businesses.
- [Advanced Analytics & Business Intelligence](https://utkarshgupta.com/services/data-analytics.html): Interactive dashboards, KPI tracking, cohort analysis, and data visualization solutions.
- [Process Automation & AI Agents](https://utkarshgupta.com/services/automation-solutions.html): Intelligent automation for workflows, document processing, automated reporting, and AI agent solutions.

- [Your Company Doesn't Need More AI Tools. It Needs an AI Strategy.](https://utkarshgupta.com/blog/ai-strategy-for-business.html): A practical guide for business leaders on building an AI strategy. Covers the AI tool trap, 5-step framework for AI prioritization, common mistakes US companies make, and how to move from scattered AI experiments to a cohesive strategy that drives measurable ROI.
- [It's All Automation, Not Just AI: The Real Revolution](https://utkarshgupta.com/blog/ai-powered-automation-not-just-ai.html): Why the real AI value comes from automation powered by AI, not just AI tools. Includes real-world examples of lead follow-up automation, self-building financial reports, and automated customer support.
- [Never Miss a Load Again: AI Sales Agent for Freight Brokers](https://utkarshgupta.com/blog/ai-agent-freight-brokers.html): How a 24/7 AI agent captures every inquiry and converts it into revenue automatically for freight brokers.
- [How AI Actually Helps in Analytics Today](https://utkarshgupta.com/blog/how-ai-helps-in-analytics.html): A practical look at how artificial intelligence is genuinely improving data analytics for businesses today.
- [How to Build a Business Intelligence Engine Using AI](https://utkarshgupta.com/blog/building-ai-business-intelligence-engine.html): Step-by-step guide on building a modern, AI-powered business intelligence engine from scratch.
- [How AI Is Transforming Business Analytics in 2026](https://utkarshgupta.com/blog/ai-analytics-business-guide.html): Comprehensive guide on where AI meets analytics and how businesses can use it to get ahead.
- [How to Choose an AI Consultant or AI Consulting Firm](https://utkarshgupta.com/blog/choosing-ai-consultant.html): Guide to evaluating and hiring an AI consultant, including what to look for and red flags to avoid.
